purpose: Expand company-level public research beyond the authorized 47-row discovery Sheet without creating contact records or commercial-stage leads.

authority.request_scope: Current public company research and source-method design only.
permitted: Read-only official public company and recipient dataset inspection
Company-level identity, domain, category, observable public condition, and provenance storage after privacy filtering
not_permitted: Raw search or source payload persistence
authority.legal_or_contractual_rights_note: This artifact records current public access and internal use boundaries. It is not a legal opinion. Source-specific terms and robots controls still apply.

exa_company_search.safe_conclusion: Exa is callable as an ephemeral company locator and raw-result persistence remains prohibited. A pure-local company allowlist now passes 10 adversarial tests, but recurring activation still requires safe upstream projection, canonical dedupe, conflict and suppression reads, query approval, source terms, and per-batch QA.

source_manifest.normal_lane_role: Discover a small bounded set of company homepage locators. Never treat snippets or enriched fields as current first-party truth.

batch_capacity.capacity_reason: The pure-local allowlist is tested but no recurring collector is connected to it. Manual privacy-safe extraction may proceed within the shared daily cap.

hard_stops: Any people-category query
Any implementation that logs raw results
No resolvable first-party domain
Ambiguous identity
A source-rights, duplicate, relationship, or suppression conflict

source_manifest.normal_lane_role: Confirm company identity and record one reproducible public observation from the official site.
hard_stops: Login or consent gate
Robots or terms restriction
Unresolved redirect or domain conflict
Only directory or social evidence exists
No reproducible company-level observation

source_manifest.normal_lane_role: Optional discovery of businesses seeking federal contracts. Verify every retained identity on its first-party site.
hard_stops: No explicit public API or export-use authority verified
Federal-contractor or existing-vendor conflict
Identity not reproducible from a first-party public site

source_manifest.normal_lane_role: Resolve current public-filer legal identity and filing recency. It is a narrow public-company lane, not a general SMB source.
source_controls: Use a declared runtime user agent without storing contact data in this artifact
Stay below the published 10 requests per second maximum
Download only the bounded records needed
Prefer company submissions metadata over free-form filing text
hard_stops: Entity is a fund or individual
Current first-party domain cannot be resolved
Public-company size or service fit is outside the target lane
Any relationship, client, partner, vendor, or suppression conflict

source_manifest.normal_lane_role: Find company-level federal award recipients by bounded business category, then verify the identity and need from first-party public sources.
hard_stops: Recipient is a government entity, individual, client, partner, vendor, employer, or separate venture
No current first-party company identity
Government-award history is the only evidence of service fit or buyer need
Any suppression or relationship conflict

sources_not_authorized_for_recurring_ing.reason: Contact discovery and personal records are outside the current authority.
No direct LinkedIn connector or authenticated research authority is proven, and personal profile data is prohibited in this lane.
Public visibility does not prove bulk extraction, storage, or reuse rights. A specific licensed connector or source review is required.
Availability, terms, fields, and business-purpose restrictions vary by jurisdiction.
They are locators or hypotheses only and cannot independently prove identity, fit, need, authority, or current status.

dedupe_contract.review_only_key: normalized company name plus country, never used alone for automatic merge
canonical_comparison_sets: private outbound ledger without copying contact fields
dedupe_contract.merge_rule: Automatic merge requires an exact canonical domain or an exact source-stable company identifier. Name-only similarity creates a review hold.

duplicate_result_actions.exact_existing_account: attach source provenance to the existing account only after canonical-owner review
duplicate_result_actions.ambiguous_possible_match: keep separate and hold at P00
duplicate_result_actions.confirmed_cross_client_or_cross_venture_: exclude or route to the exact canonical owner

checks_required_before_any_p10_entry: active and prior IMMOHRTAL account records

account_level_checks: prior opt-out or complaint linked to the company
active client, partner, vendor, or protected relationship
suppression_contract.advancement_rule: No account may cross P20 and no contact may be discovered until an authorized canonical suppression source returns clear.

safe_batch_method.cap_scope: The eight-account cap is shared across the existing Sheet lane and every public expansion source until the canonical configuration is explicitly changed.

steps.action: Choose one approved discovery source and one explicit company-level ICP query. Record the query fingerprint and source rights state.
Retrieve no more than 10 ephemeral locator results. Never use Exa category:people.
Apply an in-memory field allowlist. Discard person, contact, address, enrichment, and raw payload fields before any file write. If redaction cannot be proven, persist zero accounts and stop.
Resolve a stable account identity and canonical first-party domain. Name-only identity stays provisional.
Dedupe against every canonical comparison set and complete relationship and business-category checks.
Read the current first-party company site and record one reproducible company-level observation, explicit unknowns, observed date, and 14-day refresh due date.
Set suppression pending unless an authorized canonical source proves clear. Withhold the 0 to 16 qualification score until every score dimension is evidenced.
Persist at most eight privacy-safe P00 records, run zero-PII and JSON validation, then require independent QA before any commercial boundary.

p20_entry_requires: score of 13 to 16 or separately approved conditional route

activation_requirements: COMPLETE 2026-08-25: Build and independently test a pure-local allowlist that has no network, filesystem, console, or raw-payload serialization path.
Add the approved public-source lane and shared cap to the canonical automation configuration.
Define one explicit ICP query and accepted business categories.
Prove source-specific terms, robots, and rate controls for any recurring automated source.
Prove canonical duplicate, relationship-conflict, and account-level suppression reads.
Require a zero-PII validation receipt before every batch is retained.
